RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Parma, Ohio operates under a mayor-council form of government. The Mayor is Timothy J. DeGeeter. The City Council consists of a President and nine Ward Council Members. Kristin Saban is listed as the Clerk of Council, but typically this is an appointed administrative role rather than an elected legislative position, and thus is not included in the list of elected officials.
